paths.name: Path of Big Shootin'
paths.description: A mastery path focused on long range bow combat

ability.name: Sharpened Arrers
ability.description: Increases the armor penetration of all your Path of Big Shootin' abilities by 15%.

ability.name: Shrapnel Arrer
ability.description: On contact, your arrow explodes into shrapnel, dealing 178 damage to your target and reduces range on their abilities to 75% for the next 3 seconds.

ability.name: I Feelz Yer Pain
ability.description:
Any time you critically hit with a Path of Big Shootin' ability, you will regain 50 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

ability.name: Poison Arrer
ability.description: Deals 733 Corporeal damage to your target.

ability.name: Aimin' Quickly
ability.description: Plink and Poison Arrer now build up 1 seconds faster

ability.name: Finish 'em Off
ability.description: Deals 816 damage if your target is below 30% hit points, or 365 damage otherwise.

ability.name: Lots Of Shootin'
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all targets within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Plink
coreAbilities.description: A well aimed arrow that deals 436 damage.

coreAbilities.name: What Blocka?
coreAbilities.description: An attack which deals 291 damage and reduces your target's armor by 990 and reduces their chance to block by 10% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Goop Shootin'
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig sprays out corrosive slime towards an enemy, dealing 265 damage to all targets within 20 feet of the victim. While frenzied, this ability will reduce the enemy's Corporeal resistance by 240 for 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Explodin' Arrer
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 183 Elemental damage to your target and then explodes, dealing an additional 231 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to the target and all other enemies within 20 feet of them.

coreAbilities.name: Lots o' Arrers
coreAbilities.description: You concentrate on your target for up to 3 seconds, repeatedly shooting them for 134 damage as long as you maintain your concentration.

coreAbilities.name: Spore Cloud
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig expels noxious spores towards an enemy, briefly sickening the victim and all other enemies within 25 feet of them, dealing 314 damage. Any of your Squigs, including your Battle Squig, within the radius will be healed for 178 health. While Frenzied, any ally within the radius will be healed by the damage dealt.

coreAbilities.name: Choking Arrer
coreAbilities.description: A Crippling shot that deals 328 damage and silences your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use magic.

paths.name: Path of Bouncin'
paths.description: A mastery path focused on toe-to-toe combat

ability.name: Sharp Toofs
ability.description: Git Em!'s damage is increased to 419 on your pet's first attack, and its cost is reduced by 15 Action Points.

ability.name: Squig Leap
ability.note:
Requires Squig Armor
You cannot perform this action while rooted
You cannot perform this action while airborne
ability.description: You pounce forwards, leaping towards your target. You will inflict 156 damage to them when you land. Your movement speed will subsequently be increased by 35% for 3 seconds. This speed increase will be dismissed if you use any ability.

ability.name: Sneaky Bouncin'
ability.description:
Your Squig Armor grants an additional 50% of armor from items, and your damage is increased by 15% when under 45 feet away from your target.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Bad Gas!
ability.description: You expel noxious fumes, increasing the cooldowns of enemies within 25 feet by 3 seconds for 10 seconds and dealing 95 Corporeal damage to all affected enemies.

ability.name: Sneaky Git
ability.description: While in your Squig Armor, your defenses are increased by 10%.

ability.name: Tastes Like Stuntie
ability.description: Your Battle Squig spies a tasty morsel and proceeds to take chunks out of your target for up to 5 seconds, dealing 254 damage with each hit. You share in this treat and will be healed for all damage this ability deals.

ability.name: Outta My Way!
ability.description: Channeled. You kick deep down your Squig's throat, causing it to rage. Its speed is increased by 25% for the next 10 seconds, as you plow through any enemies who dare stand in your way.

coreAbilities.name: Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: Summons a massive battle squig that eats you. While in Squig Armor, Strength, Toughness, and Wounds increase by 100. Armor is increased by half the amount gained from items. Ballistic Skill from items counts as Strength, Ranged Power as Melee Power, Dodge Strikethrough as Parry Strikethrough, and Ranged Crit as Melee Crit. This ability builds up even while moving.

coreAbilities.name: Ard Noggin
coreAbilities.note: Requires Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: A powerful attack that deals 231 damage and reduces the threat generated by your pet's next attack.

coreAbilities.name: Git Em!
coreAbilities.note: Usable in Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: You and your Squig attack together on each others target. You strike your target for 119 damage, and your pet strikes its target for 119 damage.  If you are within 35 feet of your pet's target, you will also strike that enemy for 119 damage, and likewise, if your pet is within 35 feet of your target, it will also strike your enemy for 119 damage as well.

coreAbilities.name: Cut Ya!
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 760 damage over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Gore
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig gores its target, dealing 209 damage and an additional 135 damage over 5 seconds. While frenzied, this ability will also hit all enemies within 20 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Big Claw
coreAbilities.note: Requires Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: You force your Battle Squig to claw at your target, dealing 432 damage over 9 seconds and snaring them by 40% over 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bounce
coreAbilities.note: Requires Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: You cause your Battle Squig to bounce, dealing 175 damage to all enemies, up to 20 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Head Butt
coreAbilities.description: Your squig slams its head into its target, dealing 156 damage and reducing their armor by 990 for 20 seconds. While frenzied, this ability will hit an additional time.

coreAbilities.name: Indigestion
coreAbilities.note: Requires Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: You prod the inside of your Battle Squig, causing it to deal 668 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds to all targets 40 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Drop That!!
coreAbilities.note: Requires an active pet
coreAbilities.description: On the Squig's next attack within 5 seconds, it will deal an additional 291 damage and disarm your target for 4 seconds, making them unable to use melee or ranged weapons.

coreAbilities.name: Big Bouncin!
coreAbilities.note: Requires Squig Armor
coreAbilities.description: You force your Battle Squig to bounce in the air for up to 3 seconds, repeatedly dealing 156 damage to all enemies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: KABOOM!
coreAbilities.note:
Requires Squig Armor
You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: Your Battle Squig explodes, causing you to be launched upward out of your Squig Armor. All enemies within 10 feet take 441 damage and are knocked back.

paths.name: Path of Quick Shootin'
paths.description: A mastery path focused on short range and moving bow combat

ability.name: Shootin' Quicka
ability.description: Increase autoattack speed by 50% for you and your pet as long as your pet is alive.

ability.name: Red Tipped Arrer
ability.description: You fire a quick arrow at your target, dealing 178 damage and interrupting any ability that they are building up. If an ability was interrupted it will deal 465 damage instead.

ability.name: Da Waaagh Iz Strong
ability.description: Increases durations of Yer Bleeding to 24s, Stop Runnin to 15s, and Not So Fast! to 15s.

ability.name: Rotten Arrer
ability.description: An Ailment which deals 627 damage to your target over 9 seconds and causes all healing effects used on them to become 50% weaker. Only usable on a target that is already Ailing.

ability.name: Shootin' Wif Da Wind
ability.description: Increases the ranges of all Path of Quick Shootin' abilities by 15ft.

ability.name: Run Away!
ability.note:
Requires an active pet
Not usable while inside your Squig Armor
This effect will not stack with other abilities or tactics that increase movement speed.
ability.description: You command your Squig to Taunt all enemies within 30 feet and increases your movement speed by 30 % for 10 seconds. If you use any abilities, this effect will immediately end.

ability.name: Arrer O' Mork
ability.description: Deals 1200 damage to all targets in front of you within 40 feet, and then deals an additional 1200 over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Yer Bleedin'!
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 910 damage to your target over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Stop Runnin!
coreAbilities.description: An Ailment which deals 253 damage and snares your target, reducing their run speed by 40% for 10 seconds.  This ability will continue to build up if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Run 'n Shoot
coreAbilities.description: Deals 216 damage to your target.  This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Poisoned Spine
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig injects a deadly poison into its target, dealing 300 damage over 5 seconds and reducing their chance to critically hit by  10% for 5 seconds. While frenzied, deadly spikes growing from your squig deal 132 damage to its attacker whenever it is attacked.

coreAbilities.name: Spine Fling
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig flings deadly spines at its target, dealing 178 damage every second for 3 seconds. While frenzied, the tick interval and duration is shortened by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Not So Fast!
coreAbilities.description: A Crippling shot that deals 253 damage and reduces your target's Initiative by 150 for 10 seconds.  This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Behind Ya!
coreAbilities.note: Target must be facing away from you
coreAbilities.description: A sneaky bow shot which deals 403 damage to the target.

coreAbilities.name: Bolster War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hamper War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Diminish War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Summon Squig
coreAbilities.note: You may only have 1 active pet
coreAbilities.description:
Summons a basic squig pet which you can order around. This pet is very tough, and can take quite beating.
This pet receives a bonuses to Toughness and Wounds equal to your bonus from items.
This squig generates much more hatred in enemy monsters than normal.
When you are dealt damage, there is a 25% chance that 50% of the damage is dealt to your Basic Squig, if it is within 45 feet.
Cooldown will begin when you lose control of your pet for any reason.

coreAbilities.name: Don't Eat Me
coreAbilities.description: You Detaunt your target, making them hate you less and causing them to deal 50% damage to you for 15 seconds. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Farty Squig
coreAbilities.note: Requires an active pet
coreAbilities.description: You cause your pet to explode, dealing 419 damage to enemies within 25 feet.  For the next 10 seconds, the next different squig other than the one that just exploded will be summoned instantly.

coreAbilities.name: Horned Squig
coreAbilities.note: You may only have 1 active pet
coreAbilities.description:
Summons a Horned squig pet which you can order around. This pet deals more damage than a basic squig. It is strong against physical attacks, but weak against magic.
This pet receives a bonus to Strength equal to your bonus from items. This pet receives a bonus to Toughness and Weapon Skill that is 50% of your bonus from items.
Your parry strikethrough is increased by 10% as long as this squig is alive.
Cooldown will begin when you lose control of your pet for any reason.

coreAbilities.name: Point-Blank
coreAbilities.description: A mid-range attack that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Whazat Behind You?!
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are hit, there is a 25% chance that you will Detaunt the enemy, making them hate you less and causing them to deal 80% damage to you for 5 seconds. You will also deal 80% damage to them until the effect is broken.
If you hit anyone that you have Detaunted, the effect will end.

coreAbilities.name: Gas Squig
coreAbilities.note: You may only have 1 active pet
coreAbilities.description:
Summons a Gas squig pet which you can order around. This pet attacks from range, but is very weak to attacks.
This pet receives a bonus to Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill equal to your bonus from items.
Your range attacks are increased by 15 feet as long as this squig is alive.
Cooldown will begin when you lose control of your pet for any reason.

coreAbilities.name: Sticky Squigz
coreAbilities.note: You cannot perform this action while airborne
coreAbilities.description: All enemies within 25 feet become snared, reducing movement speed by 30% for the next 5 seconds. You are knocked back away from your enemies.

coreAbilities.name: Squig Frenzy
coreAbilities.note: Requires an active pet
coreAbilities.description: You whip your pet in to a frenzy, causing it to do 25% more damage for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Spiked Squig
coreAbilities.note: You may only have 1 active pet
coreAbilities.description:
Summons a Spiked squig pet which you can order around. This pet attacks from range and has increased damage.
This pet receives a bonus to Ballistic Skill equal to 150% of your bonus from items. This pet receives a bonus to Weapon Skill equal to 50% of your bonus from items.
You gain the ability to autoattack while moving, and your chance to critically hit is increased by 5% as long as this squig is alive.
Cooldown will begin when you lose control of your pet for any reason.

coreAbilities.name: Expert Skirmisher
coreAbilities.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% when you are within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Masterful Aim
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Ballistic Skill by 160

coreAbilities.name: Concealment
coreAbilities.description: With luck and experience you are able to Dodge all ranged attacks and Disrupt all magic attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Too Smart For Dat
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Spirit resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Tastes Like Chicken
coreAbilities.note: Requires an active pet
coreAbilities.description: You eat your squig, increasing your wounds by 150 for 10 seconds and healing you for the amount increased. For the next 10 seconds, the next different squig other than the one that was just eaten will be summoned instantly.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: He's A Biggun'
coreAbilities.description: Your summoned Squig's Strength, Ballistic Skill and Wounds are increased by 160

coreAbilities.name: RUN AWAY!
coreAbilities.description: Any time you are hit, there is a 25% chance that your movement speed will be increased by 30% for 5 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Explosive Shots
coreAbilities.description:
All of your ranged attacks will explode for the next 10 seconds, dealing 300 damage to all enemies within 20 feet of your target.
This effect will not trigger more than once every second.

coreAbilities.name: Clever Recovery
coreAbilities.description:
If an enemy dodges any of your attacks, you will regain 75 Action Points.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Strength In Numbas
coreAbilities.description:
Any time one of your groupmates within 100 feet of you hits an enemy, there is a 25% chance that you will regain 75 points of Morale over 3 seconds.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Squigbeast
coreAbilities.description: Pet Buff. Increases pet damage output by 100% and increases the size of your pet for 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Pierce Defenses
coreAbilities.description: If an enemy blocks, dodges, or parries any of your attacks, their chances to dodge and parry will be reduced by 10% and their ability to block reduced by 5% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: All By Meself
coreAbilities.description:
You deal 25% more damage when you have no pets present.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Squig Goo
coreAbilities.description: Targeted  area-effect attack that deals 900 over 3 seconds to all enemies within 20 feet, and snares the targets by 60%.

coreAbilities.name: Pick On Yer Own Size
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength, Ballistic Skill, and Weapon Skill by 120, but reduces your Toughness by 120.

coreAbilities.name: Scramblin' Quick-Like
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Squig's movement speed by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Shoot Thru Ya
coreAbilities.description: A piercing arrow which deals 1800 damage to all enemies in front of you, up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: I Got Lots
coreAbilities.description: Your Squig pets no longer have cooldown times.

coreAbilities.name: Da Smell Don't Bother Me
coreAbilities.description: While in your Squig Armor, you are healed for 120 health every 5-seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Wind Up Da Waaagh
coreAbilities.description: Deals 2400 damage to all targets within 25 feet of you.

coreAbilities.name: Hail of Doom
coreAbilities.description: You focus on a spot on the ground, shooting arrows at that spot every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, hitting all enemies within 20 feet of that area for 300 damage as long as you maintain your concentration.
